name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Overhead Carry
steps: Stand tall and press a dumbbell overhead with one hand, keeping the elbow straight and the palm facing inward.
Brace your core, keep your ribs tucked down, and hold your free arm slightly out to the side for balance.
Walk forward with steady steps and level hips while keeping the dumbbell overhead.
Stop walking, lower the dumbbell to your shoulder and switch hands.
tips: Avoid overarching your lower back or letting your torso tilt away from the raised arm.
Keep your wrist straight and stack the dumbbell directly over your shoulder joint as you walk.
